name: japan-overseas-dependents
description: Free checker for Japan's tax deduction for relatives living abroad (国外居住親族の扶養控除): eligibility by age and route (¥380,000 remittance test for ages 30-69), 2026 deduction amounts under the new ¥620,000 income limit, spouse and specified-relative tables, and the documents to give your employer. Keyless JSON API + MCP.
